artifacts.bundle_name: Rabbi Pesach Wolicki Interview Audio Bundle

nodes.name: Josh Hammer September 9 Retweet Context Investigation
nodes.description: Persistent investigative target: whether the September 9, 2025 9:09 p.m. ET retweet (A-1236.1) had an articulable contextual anchor. Direct entries: host asserts none; Yashar Ali (A-1237.1) proposes Iryna Zhuravska anchor (disputed by host); Matt Walsh comparative (A-1238.1); Hammer's historical anchors (A-1239.2) demonstrate he has only previously invoked public execution in visceral real-time response (Uvalde 2022).

nodes.name: UVU Left-Side Footage Black Hole
nodes.description: Investigation target: the absence of video from the audience's left / Charlie's left side at the September 10 UVU event. Host issues All-Points Bulletin to UVU attendees for footage of older males with hair tied in ponytails or buns, and from the missing-angle sector.

nodes.name: Candace Kill Switch / Dead Man Switch
nodes.description: Investigation target / verification node: the existence, recipients, and content of Candace Owens's "kill switch" — confirmed by Alex Jones audio (A-1246.1) to include Max Blumenthal, Tucker Carlson, Tate brothers, Dave Smith, and others. James O'Keefe precedent cited by Jones.

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk Final-Days Text Communications
nodes.description: Investigation target: the existence and provenance of text communications from Charlie Kirk on or around the day of his death, specifically (a) "they are going to kill me" texts to unnamed recipients, and (b) texts expressing concern about Israel infringing on American speech. Host references both; neither artifact is displayed in this episode.

nodes.name: Hamptons Meeting Verification

Reference is host narrative; the episode's matching audio artifacts come from the JTV and Wolicki interviews (A-1242.1, A-1243.1) concerning a different meeting.

claims.label: Josh Hammer Retweeted 2013 Trump Public-Execution Tweet on September 9, 2025
claims.claim: Approximately 16 hours before Charlie Kirk's assassination, Josh Hammer retweeted an April 19, 2013 Donald Trump post advocating public executions and added the one-word reply "Based."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify retweet timestamp via X archive (Wayback Machine) and compare against official timeline of events on September 9–10, 2025.

claims.label: Yashar Ali Publicly Attempted to Contextualize Hammer's Retweet as Referring to Iryna Zhuravska
claims.claim: Yashar Ali posted a quote-tweet asserting the Hammer retweet referenced the Iryna Zhuravska murder and that other conservatives were sharing similar material the day prior.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Yashar Ali's exact post text and timing against X archives; verify whether the "day prior" framing matches the post dates of alleged "many conservatives."

claims.label: Iryna Zhuravska Murder Timeline — Murder August 22, Footage Released and Trended September 5
claims.claim: Iryna Zhuravska was murdered on August 22, 2025; her perpetrator was arrested the same day; the footage was released and trended on X on September 5, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify dates against Charlotte-Mecklenburg Police Department records, news archives, and X trend timelines.

claims.label: Tucker Carlson, at Charlie Kirk's Memorial, Drew an Analogy Between Critics and Those Who Plotted Against Jesus
claims.claim: Tucker Carlson, delivering remarks at Charlie Kirk's memorial, analogized the actions of critics and liars to the plot against Jesus in Jerusalem 2,000 years ago.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the full memorial transcript and locate the segment within the recording.

claims.label: Josh Hammer Did Not, in His Media Discussion of Iryna Zhuravska, Advocate the Death Penalty
claims.claim: In his media appearance with host Gabriel discussing the Iryna Zhuravska case, Hammer discussed criminal justice standards, media coverage double-standards, and safety — but did not call for or reference the death penalty.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the full segment transcript and any accompanying written material Hammer posted in that window.

claims.label: Matt Walsh Posted an X Post Calling for "Public Execution" on September 5, 2025
claims.claim: Matt Walsh posted on X on September 5, 2025, calling for public execution, hard labor, and long prison terms in a visceral response to the Iryna footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify post date and content via X archives.

claims.label: Hammer's Sole Prior Public Reference to "Public Execution" Was a 2022 Post About the Uvalde Shooter
claims.claim: Prior to September 9, 2025, Josh Hammer's only documented reference to public execution came in a 2022 post discussing the Uvalde shooter (also referencing the Buffalo shooter).
claims.investigative_direction: Query X archive for "public execution" within Hammer's account history; verify no other prior episodes.

claims.label: Hammer's First X Post After Charlie Kirk's Death Promoted His Book
claims.claim: Josh Hammer's first X post following the announcement of Charlie Kirk's death included a claim that Charlie had told him during their last call that he would plug Hammer's book on his campus tour.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check with post timestamp against major news outlets' confirmation-of-death timestamps.

claims.label: Hammer Stated in JTV Interview That Charlie's Last Words to Him Concerned Plugging Hammer's Book
claims.claim: On JTV (in interview with host Ali), Josh Hammer stated that Charlie Kirk's last words to him referenced his intent to plug Hammer's book "Israel and Civilization" in response to Israel-related questions on the campus tour.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify full JTV segment; corroborate against any Hamptons-meeting or post-call text-chain documentation.

claims.label: Rabbi Pesach Wolicki Acknowledged Charlie Criticized Some Israeli Policy
claims.claim: In his post-assassination interview, Rabbi Pesach Wolicki stated that Charlie Kirk "certainly had some disagreements with Israeli policy and he criticized Israel where he felt appropriate" and that there were "people around him in the America First movement who were actively working on him to try to get him to turn on Israel."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify full Wolicki interview; obtain unedited transcript.

claims.label: Wolicki Stated Charlie Called the Pre-Tour Meeting Himself for the Purpose of Preparing Israel Talking Points
claims.claim: Wolicki stated the pre-assassination meeting was called by Charlie, was on the schedule for weeks, and was for the purpose of preparing Israel-related talking points for Charlie's new campus tour starting in Utah.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify full Wolicki interview; cross-check with documented calendar entries and Zoom records.

claims.label: Dinesh D'Souza Posted an X Post Comparing Candace Owens to a "Freak Show" and Bestiality on October 8, 2025
claims.claim: On the morning of October 8, 2025, Dinesh D'Souza posted on X comparing Candace Owens to a "freak show" and a farmer having sex with a sheep, with the stated intent of discouraging viewership.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify post timestamp and any subsequent deletion; verify Yishai reply and any subsequent post changes.

claims.label: Alex Jones Confirmed Candace Activated a "Kill Switch" Distributed to Multiple Named Recipients
claims.claim: Alex Jones, on his show, confirmed that Candace Owens sent a "dead man's switch" / "kill switch" data package to multiple recipients including Max Blumenthal, Tucker Carlson, the Tate brothers, and Dave Smith.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the recipients directly with named individuals; verify the contents of the package.

claims.label: Alex Jones Cited the James O'Keefe Prince Andrew Disclosure as Precedent
claims.claim: Alex Jones cited James O'Keefe's dead-man-switch disclosure in the Prince Andrew case as a comparable precedent for the danger and effectiveness of Candace's kill switch.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify O'Keefe's actual mechanism; obtain O'Keefe's primary disclosure.

claims.label: A Letter Read Aloud on Air Asserted Critics Were "Lying Through Their Teeth"
claims.claim: A letter to which host was given access asserted that "Tucker, Candace, and other bad-faith actors are lying through their teeth about Charlie and Israel."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the letter and author; verify authenticity.

claims.label: Josh Hammer Posted "Jew hatred is inherent in the European DNA" in 2019 and Later Deleted It
claims.claim: Josh Hammer posted on X in 2019 the statement "Jew hatred is inherent in the European DNA," and subsequently deleted the post.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via web archives / Wayback Machine or third-party screen captures; verify deletion via X account audit.

claims.label: Josh Hammer Tweeted Nine Times on September 9, 2025 Before the 9:09 p.m. ET Public-Execution Retweet
claims.claim: On September 9, 2025, Josh Hammer posted nine X items covering Phillies story, Iryna media link, anti-Tucker, pro-Israel/anti-Qatar, anti-Saudi, second anti-Tucker, Hebrew Bible / Western civilization, Supreme Court media appearance, and concluded with the 9:09 p.m. ET public-execution retweet.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify each timestamp and content against X archive.

claims.label: Tyler Bowyer Has Made Accusatory X Posts Against Candace Owens's Coverage
claims.claim: Tyler Bowyer posted accusatory content on X, calling people names rather than addressing substantive questions.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture and verify direct screenshots of Bowyer's X posts.

claims.label: UVU Has a Documentary Footage Black Hole on Charlie's Left Side
claims.claim: There is an almost incomprehensible lack of footage from Charlie's left side (audience right) of the UVU event; Turning Point has not released high-resolution footage of that angle.
claims.investigative_direction: Submit evidence requests to UVU, Turning Point USA, and individual attendee videographers; FOIA/records requests where applicable.

claims.label: UVU Had a Specific Suspect Profile Sought by Host — Older Males with Long Hair Tied in Ponytail or Bun
claims.claim: Host is specifically requesting footage of older males with long hair tied in ponytails or buns at the UVU event.
claims.investigative_direction: Tip-line intake processing and review of footage submitted to tips@candaceowens.com.

claims.label: Host referenced Laura Loomer in closing segment
claims.claim: Host references Laura Loomer in closing remarks (parody/cartoon antagonist framing).
claims.investigative_direction: Locate exact closing-segment timestamp and any on-screen graphic.
